title: Component instance
description: A placement of a ComponentDefinition inside a document. Instances live ONLY inside document JSONB (node.type = 'component'); the server maintains a derived index table (component_usages) on every save for where-used / impact analysis. The reference is always to an exact definition version: drafts may be upgraded explicitly by the editor, published versions are pinned forever.

props.description: Overrides of the definition's property defaults. Validated against the referenced definition version's property schema by the semantic validator.

definitionKey.description: Denormalized for readability/debugging; definitionId is authoritative.
